examples: Open settings > account > sign in, or go to #account: signed in it shows your handle, email, provider and a switch for the carnivore news email.
how_to: Open settings and press the account row, or open #account. Signed in: change the news email switch, review and sign out your devices, export or delete your account data, or sign out. Signed out: read what the account unlocks and press sign in or create your free account.
On the skills screen, signed out, one line asks you to sign in to rate, comment and publish and opens the same sign in modal.
media_exempt: A page whose screenshot is captured before the next version bump.
name: Carnivore account page
summary: one page for your free carnivore account: who you are, the news email, devices, your data, and sign out.
